create_ensemble_indexer: create an EnsembleIndexer with a given number of ensemble members to sample random integer indices
create_gaussian_indexer: create a GaussianIndexer that samples index vectors from a standard normal distribution N(0, I)
create_scaled_gaussian_indexer: create a ScaledGaussianIndexer with a configurable index_dim and index_scale for normalized random indices
create_dirichlet_indexer: create a DirichletIndexer that samples index vectors from a Dirichlet distribution with a given alpha parameter
use_gaussian_with_unit_indexer: use a GaussianWithUnitIndexer to produce index vectors prepended with 1 for unit ball sampling
